description: Hand-authored offline baseline cases. Expected results are derived by reasoning about the replay semantics defined in spec.md. They must NOT be generated by running the replay engine. Each case includes a rationale explaining the expected outcome.

cases.name: 01_at_bound
cases.description: START at t=0, END at t=4: distance equals bound, classified at_bound.
cases.rationale: delta=4-0=4 equals bound=4, so at_bound. Bin rel.offline.single.at_bound gets 1 hit. 1 of 2 bins observed.

cases.name: 02_above_bound
cases.description: START at t=0, END at t=7: distance exceeds bound, classified above_bound.
cases.rationale: delta=7-0=7 > bound=4, so above_bound. 1 of 2 bins observed.

cases.name: 03_below_bound_violation
cases.description: START at t=0, END at t=3: distance below bound, violation, no legal bin hit.
cases.rationale: delta=3-0=3 < bound=4, so below_bound (violation). bin_id stays null; violations count=1. 0 bins observed.

cases.name: 04_no_history
cases.description: END with no prior START in scope: suppressed, no_history.
cases.rationale: No prior START latched for scope (0,0,0). END is an end_command so an opportunity is counted, but no history means suppressed with reason no_history.

cases.name: 05_latest_start_wins
cases.description: Two STARTs, END uses the latest START (latest_start policy).
cases.rationale: START@0 latches, START@2 overwrites (latest_start). END@6 measures 6-2=4=bound, at_bound. start_event_id=s1 not s0.

cases.name: 06_reset_clears_history
cases.description: START, then reset event, then END: reset clears scope history, END finds no history.
cases.rationale: START@0 latches history. Reset@1 clears it (kind=reset) and continues without producing a sample. END@4 finds no prior, suppressed no_history. No diagnostic: reset events do not generate diagnostics.

cases.name: 07_cross_rank_independent
cases.description: START on rank 0, END on rank 1 (different scope, suppressed), END on rank 0 (at_bound).
cases.rationale: Scope=(ch,sub,rank). START@0 latches for scope (0,0,0). END@4 on rank 1 is scope (0,0,1) with no prior, suppressed. END@4 on rank 0 is scope (0,0,0) with prior=s0, delta=4=bound, at_bound. Different scopes may share the same timestamp.

cases.name: 08_config_epoch_change
cases.description: START at config_epoch=0, END at config_epoch=1: epoch change clears history.
cases.rationale: START@0 latches at epoch (0,0). END@4 has config_epoch=1, so epoch becomes (1,0). Epoch change clears history before evaluating. END finds no prior, suppressed no_history.

cases.name: 09_reset_epoch_change
cases.description: START at reset_epoch=0, END at reset_epoch=1: epoch change clears history.
cases.rationale: START@0 latches at epoch (0,0). END@4 has reset_epoch=1, epoch becomes (0,1). Epoch change clears history. END finds no prior, suppressed no_history.

cases.name: 10_invalid_event_clears
cases.description: START, invalid END (valid=false), then valid END: invalid observation suppresses and clears history.
cases.rationale: START@0 latches. END@4 is valid=false: it IS an end_command so an opportunity is counted. Prior exists (s0) so start_event_id=s0, but valid=false means reason=invalid_observation, outcome=suppressed. The invalid event also clears history (histories.pop) and generates a diagnostic. END@6 then finds no prior (cleared), suppressed no_history.

cases.name: 11_duplicate_idempotent
cases.description: START, END, then exact duplicate of both: duplicates ignored, no extra samples.
cases.rationale: First s0 and e1 produce one at_bound sample. Second s0 and e1 are exact duplicates (same event_id and same content), so they are idempotent: duplicates_ignored=2, no additional samples or bin hits.

cases.name: 12_self_overlap
cases.description: START is both start and end command. First START has no prior (suppressed), second START measures against first (at_bound).
cases.rationale: START is in end_commands=[START,END]. s0@0: evaluated as end first, no prior, suppressed no_history. Then latched as start (measure-before-update). s1@4: evaluated as end, prior=s0, delta=4=bound, at_bound. Then latched as new start.

cases.name: 13_multi_rule_shared
cases.description: Two rules: START->END (bound=4) and END->DONE (bound=5). END is end for rule A and start for rule B.
cases.rationale: s0(START): latches for rule_a only (not end for either rule). e1(END): rule_a evaluates START->END delta=4=bound, at_bound. Then rule_b latches END as its start. d2(DONE): rule_b evaluates END->DONE delta=10-4=6>5, above_bound. 2 rules x 2 outcomes = 4 total bins, 2 observed.
